niche: choosing the one winter scheme an acute trust funds for its medical bed base, sized by the bed-days each would have released over the last winter, when infectious patients can be nursed only in side rooms and a bay with one in it closes whenever every medical side room is full
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every record and the trust's winter capacity framework correctly sizes each scheme with the bed model, the medical beds as one pool (beds added times days, bed-days taken out of the stays a scheme touches), and funds the modular ward; only crediting each scheme with the bays that stay open because it frees a side room at the moments every medical side room is full funds the palliative rapid-discharge partnership.
domain_test: Bed planning sizes a winter scheme by replaying the winter's bed use with the scheme in place, and infection control makes side rooms a separate pool that infectious patients alone can use and whose shortage closes a whole bay, so what a scheme releases turns on the side rooms it frees at the moments they bind; with classrooms or server racks for wards there are no bays, side rooms or isolation and the call no longer reads.
layer1: patient-administration bed movements by bed code, with ward codes renamed part way through the year
the infection prevention team's closure log by ward name and bay letter, not bed code
a daily bed state at 23:59 local time across the October and March clock changes
microbiology results keyed by NHS number while the bed movements carry the hospital number
the palliative team's fast-track register with decision times entered after the fact
stakeholder_role: head of patient flow and capacity at an acute NHS foundation trust

spine.entity: one patient's stay in one bed

driver: The decisive quantity is what a scheme releases from a resource split into two pools, when the units that need the small pool can use nothing else and a full small pool takes a whole block of the large pool out of use, so valuing each scheme at the large-pool capacity it adds or frees misses the blocks it keeps open by emptying small-pool places at the moments the small pool is full.
driver_concrete: A winter scheme is worth the medical bed-days it would have released over the 2025/26 winter; an infectious patient can be nursed only in a side room and a bay with one in it closes to admissions whenever every medical side room is full, so the palliative rapid-discharge partnership, whose fast-track patients hold side rooms while they wait for their package, keeps bays open and releases more than the modular ward, which the bed model funds.
stump: A competent analyst sizes each scheme with the bed model, treating the medical beds as one pool, and funds the modular ward; the step that lands it there is counting a side room as a bed, when an infectious patient can be nursed only in a side room, a bay with one in it closes whenever every medical side room is full, and the palliative partnership empties side rooms held by fast-track patients waiting for their package.

differentiation.task118: task118 v2 prices the share of a display item's gain that is new to the system rather than taken from its neighbours, and v4 values a levy cut by the welfare wedge on the quantity reached in the year; task307 v2 has no substitution, price or elasticity: a scheme is worth the bays its freed side rooms keep open while the side-room pool is full.
differentiation.task184: task184 v1 reads a shared resource's effect against the site's own record rather than its filed plan; task307 v2 reads no plan: the decisive step is that a full side-room pool closes bays, so a scheme that empties side rooms releases bays.
differentiation.task198: task198 v4 recovers an entitlement hidden under a lesser-of record; task307 v2's records are what happened, and the step is the two-pool constraint behind the bay closures, not a censored value.
differentiation.task472: task472 v1 finishes a job when its slowest parallel stream does; task307 v2 has no parallel streams: a bay closes because a separate small pool is full, and freeing that pool reopens the bay.
differentiation.task140: task140 strikes a residual after higher reservations with a dependent load; task307 v2 has no reservations or residual: the step is the shortage of a sub-pool that infectious patients alone may use.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is what an added capacity saves across a whole system whose users each choose their path given everyone else's, so pricing the time saved on the improved element at today's loads credits it with users who would arrive from parallel paths into a downstream element that binds, and ranks first the element that saves least once the system re-settles.
lineage.stump: A competent solver prices each project on its own links at the regional model's no-build volumes and funds the Route 9 widening; the step that lands it there is holding every trip on its no-build route, when trips re-route once a project opens, the widened segment feeds the Route 9 bridge that binds downstream, and the Center Street Bridge lane pulls trips off Route 9.
